name: Stress — Concurrent tool calls don't clobber
mechanical_verification: Run 3 tools concurrently, verify each returns correct individual result
prompt: call lint target=/tmp & call symbols target=/tmp & call complexity_hotspots target=/tmp & wait

verification_steps.action: call lint target=/tmp && call symbols target=/tmp && call complexity_hotspots target=/tmp
verification_steps.expected: All 3 tools return results without interference
verification_steps.mechanical_pass: Each tool returns its own result (string output)

pass_criteria.no_interference: lint output is lint output, symbols output is symbols output (not mixed)

failure_modes.resource_conflict: One tool blocks another, or 'resource busy' error
